verdicts.factCheck: Gerrit REST returns CL 841425 (master, MERGED 2026-09-30, cmd/compile: teach deadstore about CondSelect) and CL 845967 (release-branch.go1.26, MERGED 2026-10-27 20:10:11). go.dev/doc/devel/release says go1.26.10 and go1.27.3 were released 2026-10-19 with crypto/x509 security fixes only, and go1.26.11 and go1.27.4 were released 2026-11-10 with compiler fixes. The go1.26.10 compile.go has branchelim at line 479 and dead auto elim at line 481; go1.24.13 compile.go has dead auto elim at line 477 before branchelim at line 480. go1.26.10 deadstore.go line 320 marks an auto used for memory, flags, Phi and memory-arg values only; go1.26.11 deadstore.go line 320 adds OpCondSelect. web3_clientVersion queried today: bsc-dataseed1 Geth/v1.8.2/linux-amd64/go1.26.10, api.avax.network avalanchego/1.15.3 go=1.26.10, arb1 and Robinhood nitro v3.13.0-rc.9+b72783f go1.27.3. polygon-bor-rpc.publicnode.com returned a Cloudflare challenge to my query and polygon.drpc.org hides the version, so the Polygon go1.26.10 build string rests on the author's shapevec-137.json record and the bor v2.11.1 go.mod directive go 1.26.10, which I fetched. GitHub issue pages returned 403 to me; the Gerrit records carry the same facts. The uint256 v1.3.2 uint256.go in the work tree is byte identical to the proxy.golang.org zip.
verdicts.codeCheck: The PoolManager paths named execute SIGNEXTEND, SDIV, SMOD and SAR: src/types/Slot0.sol:49 signextend(2, shr(TICK_OFFSET, _packed)); src/libraries/TickBitmap.sol:19-28 signextend, sdiv, smod, slt; src/libraries/LiquidityMath.sol:12 signextend(15, y). No addmod occurs in src/ or lib/solmate/src (grep), consistent with ADDMOD absent from the runtime. In uint256 v1.3.2 AddMod (uint256.go:215-245) the reassigned x and y are subsequently read, so the loadAddr exclusion applies and no pointer CondSelect forms; the u256dump file has no pointer typed CondSelect. The shapevec files show 2340 of 2340 vectors run with 0 mismatches on 56, 137, 43114, 42161, 4663 and 42220. No path to other users' funds exists in the finding, and none was found.

The Polygon build string was not reproduced by the verifier because the endpoint served a Cloudflare challenge. Actor operator is acceptable: no site exists, and any future site would need an operator to run the affected build.

Client versions as in verdict 0; forno.celo.org answered both Geth/v0.1.0-untagged-c7ed55b8-20260817/linux-amd64/go1.24.13 and reth/v2.2.0-74cc8bb across five queries, matching the finding. GitHub issue 82839 returned 403 to me, so the affected version list (go1.26.6 onward, and the go1.24.13 variant) rests on the author's reading; the code text supports the mechanism.
verdicts.codeCheck: uint256 v1.3.2 ExtendSign (uint256.go:1260-1300, proxy copy identical) holds sextByte := uint64(int64(int8(signByte))) at line 1275; the int8 operand is a truncation of a uint64, not x plus a constant, and the result is only shifted and or-ed; the branches test byteNum.GtUint64(30) and switch on the uint64 signWordIndex. So the trigger cannot form there. The PoolManager SIGNEXTEND users src/types/Slot0.sol:49, src/libraries/TickBitmap.sol:20-21 and src/libraries/LiquidityMath.sol:12 depend on this handler, and the shapevec files show 0 mismatches over 2340 vectors on six networks.
